title: Stones on the Table
statement_md:
There are n stones in a row, each red (R), green (G), or blue (B). Count the minimum number of stones to remove so that no two neighboring stones share a color.

**Input**
Line 1: n (1 <= n <= 50)
Line 2: a string of length n over {R,G,B}

**Output**
A single integer: the minimum number of stones to remove.
